rules.description: Verify MaxDate is within allowable publication lag (4 years for annual series, 6 years for quinquennial census) and values are non-negative (and within [0, 100] for rates) across all 83 indicators

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, NumPlaces, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Count_(Student|Teacher|Death|MortalityEvent|Person_(Employed|Unemployed|NotInLaborForce))|UnemploymentRate_Person)') THEN 4 ELSE 6 END) AND total_svs >= 83 AND NumPlaces >= 1 AND MinValue >= 0 AND (StatVar != 'UnemploymentRate_Person' OR MaxValue <= 100)

rules.description: Ensure all 66 Population Census indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure annual Labor Force Survey indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure School Basic Survey teacher indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure School Basic Survey student enrollment indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure Vital Statistics total death and cause-of-death indicators share a consistent MaxDate
